sql: select toUInt8(count() = 2) from (select distinct v.note from gold.ssas_fact_bsc_manual_value as v inner join gold.ssas_dim_bsc_kpi as k on k.bsc_kpi_key = v.bsc_kpi_key where k.kpi_code = 'CUS_PREMS' and v.branch_key in (1, 6) and v.month_date_key = 20260701 and v.note in ('Abha', 'Rabwah'))

name: BSC Manual Note, measure KPI is blank
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISBLANK(CALCULATE([BSC Manual Note], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "FIN_NET_REVENUE", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202607))))
